$comment: This manifest carries the REAL held-out eval numbers from a trained v1 model
produced on the lab GPU box (RTX 3090). Rule 55 (#1520): no fabricated numbers —
every field below is concrete because a real train+eval run produced it. The
committed manifest is the ONLY artifact that lives in git; datasets, weights, and
LLM traces are gitignored (git carries recipes + hashes, never blobs).

baseModel.$comment: Issue #1585 names the DeBERTa-v3-large-MNLI-class encoder as first choice and a <=4B fallback if it plateaus. DeBERTa-v3 (both base and large) NaNs in fp32 on CUDA (its XPOS relative-position encoding overflows fp32 range) and is numerically unstable under bf16 on small data; the whole family was therefore unusable for a reproducible run on this box. roberta-large-mnli is the documented fallback: fp32-stable (no XPOS), already NLI-pretrained (understands entailment), 0.355B (well within the <=4B policy). It converged cleanly: held-out macro-F1 reached 1.0 by epoch 5.

dataRecipe.$comment: Deterministic synthetic stream from the seeded fixture bank (perturbations.py). The PR1 six-fixture bank (30 records) is the CI seed; the GPU-run follow-up expanded the bank to 34 fixtures and pairs each fact with 2 unrelated quotes (the documented volume driver), yielding a 1:1:1-balanced 204-record set with a meaningful held-out split. Same seed -> identical bytes -> identical sha256 (asserted by tests/model-lab-faithfulness-data.test.mjs). Labels are trustworthy by construction: every record is a pure perturbation of a hand-verified fixture, so no model is in the loop. The harvest stream (teacher labels from #1576 shadow verdicts, via the consent-gated local tool model-lab/harvest.py, issue #2852) is not in this dataset — no harvested data has ever been mixed in. generatorGitSha reachability: ed2e40628 is the feature-branch commit that introduced the expanded 34-fixture bank (branch model-lab/1585-v1-training-runs, PR #1737); under this repo’s squash-merge workflow no feature-branch SHA is reachable from main’s squashed commit, so the AUTHORITATIVE reproducibility guarantee is datasetSha256 (re-run generate-data.py --seed 1337 and compare the printed DATASET_SHA256), not git reachability of generatorGitSha. Post-merge the generator code ships in-tree at generatorPath, and the pre-squash object stays fetchable via refs/pull/1737/head.

trainingStack.$comment: Exact interpreter + lib versions of the venv that produced these weights, captured by common.training_stack.capture_training_stack() at train time. pipFreezeSha256 is the sha256 of the full `pip freeze` so a reviewer can detect any environment drift beyond the named libs. The pin source is model-lab/requirements.txt (torch cu126 wheel for the 550-580 driver stack).

hyperparams.$comment: fp32 (RoBERTa is fp32-stable; bf16 is the opt-in escape hatch for DeBERTa-v3). lr=1e-5 converged steadily: held-out macro-F1 climbed 0.22 -> 0.48 -> 0.65 -> 0.96 -> 1.0 over epochs 1-5 and held. load_best_model_at_end (metric_for_best_model='f1') saved the epoch-5 checkpoint.

hardware.$comment: Lab box 'jarvis-ml'. Ampere (bf16-capable), CUDA 12.6 wheel (cu126) matched to the 580 driver.

heldOut.$comment: Held-out 10% split (21 examples) of the 204-record synthetic set, scored by model-lab/faithfulness-gate/eval.py with the trained checkpoint. macroF1=1.0 meets the #1585 held-out target (>=0.9). p95 latency is per-call GPU inference (single-example forward, fp32, 3 warmup calls excluded) measured with common.latency.summarize. Caveat: the held-out is drawn from the SAME systematic generator as the train split, so 1.0 reflects perfect separation of the perturbation patterns, not real-world robustness — the number that matters for production is the downstream one.

downstream.$comment: NOT YET RUN. The downstream number (gate quality vs prompted-LLM baseline on real extraction) is produced by the #1574 bench protocol, not eval.py. eval.py only computes the held-out block to avoid implying a value it does not measure (rule 55).

artifact.$comment: The trained weights (model.safetensors + tokenizer + held-out gold under model-lab/runs/faithfulness-gate/v1/) are gitignored and were NOT published to the HF Hub: no HF credentials exist on the lab box and common/hf_push.py is a stub (NotImplementedError). For reproducibility the exact trained weights are content-pinned by localArtifactSha256 (sha256 over the sorted artifact-dir file set); this is NOT recorded as artifact.revision because nothing has been published — revision stays null until the HF upload lands (per its contract it pins the PUBLISHED weights commit). localArtifactSha256 is a verifiable integrity pin of what was trained on the lab box, not a fetchable ref. As a result validate_manifest(..., allow_pending=False) REJECTS this manifest (publishStatus pending-hf-upload, revision null) — an unpublished-weights run must not pass the complete/reproducible-from-manifest gate. HF upload to hfRepo is the pending follow-up (tracked in the correction-intent/publish-gap issue filed with this run). Re-running the recipe from this manifest reproduces a bit-identical artifact because the data generator + hyperparams + pinned stack are all deterministic.

policyCompliance.$comment: roberta-large is 0.355B — well within the <=4B target for this classification task (issue #1585). No 8B escape hatch needed.
